summary.en: Chinese coast guard and navy vessels are expanding combat-readiness patrols, water-cannon drills and have moved the carrier Liaoning into the western Pacific, prompting alarms from the Philippines, Taiwan and Japan. China is threatening to cut undersea cables linking Taiwan and the Philippines and is suspected of surveying cables near Japan, while Chinese coast guard ships are harassing shipping in the West Philippine Sea and Dongsha waters. The Philippine Coast Guard is delivering fuel to fishermen at Scarborough Shoal, rescuing a ferry off Quezon Province, assisting over 150,000 sea travelers during Undas and formalizing a partnership with the University of the Philippines. 176 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Kinesiske kystvakt- og marineskip utvider patruljer med kampberedskap, vannkanonøvelser og har flyttet hangarskipet Liaoning til det vestlige Stillehavet, noe som har vekket alarm fra Filippinene, Taiwan og Japan. Kina truer med å kutte undersjøiske kabler som knytter Taiwan og Filippinene, og mistenkes for å kartlegge kabler nær Japan, mens kinesiske kystvaktskip trakasserer skipstrafikken i Vest-Philippinske hav og Dongsha-vannene. Filippinernes kystvakt leverer drivstoff til fiskere ved Scarborough-skjæra, redder en ferge utenfor Quezon-provinsen, bistår over 150 000 sjøreisende under Undas og formaliserer et partnerskap med University of the Philippines. 176 kamprelaterte dødsfall ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Moro conflict
background.extract: The Moro conflict was an insurgency in the Mindanao region in southern Philippines which involved multiple armed groups. A decades-long peace process has resulted in peace deals between the Philippine government and two major armed groups, the Moro National Liberation Front (MNLF) and the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF), but other smaller armed groups continue to exist. In 2017, the peace council settled around 138 clan conflicts.
